title: First founder-facing Infinite Goal Chase closure on canonical main

founder_intent_refs: Current Alfonso master coding directive sections 0-53
Current clarification: first goal chase includes Infinite Goal Chase and far-future sci-fi goals
baseline: main@bcbb1ab4: DurableWorkflow + EventSpine + ConsequenceGate + EvidenceLedger + GenomeRegistry

alternatives.revival_evidence: All acceptance and adversarial gates pass.

roles.position: Protect the founder-facing closed loop and complete far-future horizon.
material_concerns: Do not substitute a backend module or retire later generations.

roles.position: Compose canonical main owners; preserve all unmerged runtime competitors.
material_concerns: No parallel authority, event, task or workflow truth.

roles.position: Only the bounded sandbox experiment is admissible.
material_concerns: Synthetic authentication and local locks are not production custody or hostile-process isolation.

roles.position: Use callable triggers and canonical durable workflow with explicit reconciliation.
material_concerns: An ambiguous dispatch must stop even if it reduces completion rate.

roles.position: Count only conjunctive sandbox proof; retain negative evidence and distinguish real metrics.
material_concerns: Passing fixtures cannot prove external results or attention savings.

evidence.claim: Canonical owners exist and can be composed.
evidence.finding: Source inspected; base test suite 495 passed.

counterevidence.claim: The baseline needs no agent hierarchy.
counterevidence.finding: Static durable workflow remains the protected execution baseline.

counterevidence.claim: Sandbox authentication is not production founder identity.
counterevidence.finding: Public demo key and trusted-process only; no real authorization is claimed.

pass_1.intended_outcome: One durable goal performs internal work, requests one necessary founder decision, resumes under exact bounded approval, reconciles and preserves horizon.

advantages.amplified_value: Interchangeable models and capabilities can improve without rewriting authority or losing evidence.

disadvantages.statement: New goal records could become duplicate truth.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Replay EventSpine projections; workflow cursors and Gate receipts keep canonical ownership.

disadvantages.statement: Approval callback is not authenticated founder authority.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Inject synthetic exact-scope verification, bind expiry and context, then supply existing Gate callback; real identity deferred.

disadvantages.statement: Dispatch and checkpoint are not atomic.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Recover against canonical receipts; ambiguous dispatch stops for reconciliation.

comparisons.baseline: Existing DurableWorkflow is retained as the execution provider.
comparisons.do_nothing: No new surface but closure stays zero.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: A script is simpler but must satisfy the same scope/replay requirements.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: #87/#90 offers richer primitives but unresolved runtime ownership and unmerged dependency.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: Dedicated main-based sandbox branch, fixed functions and no real adapters.

rejected_alternatives.name: Single checkpoint script
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Would recreate authentication and replay informally.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Pass identical frozen gates with demonstrably less machinery.

rejected_alternatives.name: Draft runtime and Task Fabric stack
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Would silently depend on an unresolved runtime-owner choice.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack duplicate truth, races, approval replay/spam, false evidence, candidate control of evaluation, founder overload and simulated closure inflation.

new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Nonblocking local session lock; no distributed guarantee.

new_weaknesses.statement: Candidate sees its evaluator or labels itself verified.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Freeze evaluator before runtime; pure snapshot-only built-ins; independently check before Gate records positive outcome.
Count requests and delivered messages separately; preserve failures/denials; real attention metrics remain null.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No separate store or scheduler; projections are rebuilt from canonical records.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any inconsistent replay or duplicate owner

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Only synthetic founder identity is exercised; real identity remains blocked.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any proposed real adapter or broader authority

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: A proof-complete action recovers; uncertain dispatch stops.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any ambiguous dispatch or repeated effect

pass_2.final_design: Thin sandbox goal composition on canonical main; deterministic observation/capability/authority checks, exact durable decisions, canonical workflow and receipts, quiet communication projection, frozen evaluation and fresh-process proof.

residual_risks.risk: In-process trust, public demo key, local locking and unanchored hash chain do not withstand a privileged host attacker.
residual_risks.mitigation: No untrusted code or real effects; independent review, production identity/custody, anti-rollback and dispatch reconciliation before broader use.
residual_risks.review_trigger: Any proposal to promote beyond this deterministic sandbox

dissent.handling: Five roles analyzed separately by one coding agent. Dissent remains explicit; no independent human review or consensus is claimed.

entries.review_trigger: Broader runtime integration or external adapter proposal
